metadata.title: Implement Run Method for Episode Execution

story.iWant: a convenient run() method that executes complete episodes
story.soThat: I can easily evaluate agents without manually writing episode loops
story.tasks: - Implement run(agent, render) method signature with type hints - Implement episode execution loop (reset, agent.get_action loop, return cumulative reward) - Add visualizer integration placeholder for Epic 4 - Add agent exception handling with informative error messages - Add comprehensive NumPy-style docstring with examples - Add performance validation tests (< 2s for 1000 steps headless) - Add integration tests (RandomAgent, mock agent, render modes, exception handling) - Update Environment class integration and validate with existing methods - Run all tests and ensure >90% coverage for run() method

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
**AC1:** run(agent, render) executes complete episode by calling reset(), looping agent.get_action() and step() until done, and returning final cumulative_reward
**AC2:** run() returns float (final cumulative_reward from state)
**AC3:** run() completes 1000-timestep episode in < 2 seconds (headless, render=False)
**AC4:** run() handles agent exceptions gracefully with informative error messages including agent type and timestep
**AC5:** If render=True but no visualizer, print warning and continue headless
**AC6:** Method includes comprehensive NumPy-style docstring with Parameters, Returns, Raises, Notes, and Examples sections

doc.title: FuncBench Architecture
doc.snippet: run() is convenience method wrapping reset() + step() loop. Returns float (cumulative reward) for simple interface. Headless mode (render=False) for batch evaluation. Performance: < 2s for 1000 steps (NFR3).

doc.title: FuncBench Architecture
doc.snippet: NFR3: Fast Episode Execution (< 20s with visualization, < 2s headless). Target for Epic 2 (headless): Complete 1000-timestep episode in < 2 seconds without rendering.

doc.title: FuncBench Architecture
doc.snippet: Episode loop: reset() → initialize state → loop[agent.get_action → step] → done → return cumulative_reward. Environment coordinates between agent and function via observations and actions.

artifact.reason: Main class where run() method will be added. Already has reset() and step() methods implemented in Stories 2.2-2.4.
reset() is called at start of run() to initialize episode. Returns initial observation dict.
step(action) is called in episode loop. Returns (observation, reward, done, info) tuple. Loop continues until done=True.
Can be used in tests to validate run() preserves episode history correctly.
Abstract base class. run() method accepts Agent parameter and calls agent.get_action(observation) in loop.
Called in run() episode loop to get agent's action. May raise exceptions that run() must handle gracefully.
Action constants returned by agent.get_action(). Values: 0, 1, 2.
Contains pytest fixtures: gaussian_function, environment, mock_agent. Use these in run() tests.
Existing environment tests (100 tests passing). Add new TestRunMethod class for run() tests. Follow established patterns.

python.package: NumPy for numerical operations and array handling in observations
PyGame Community Edition for visualization (Epic 4 integration, placeholder in Story 2.6)
Testing framework for unit and integration tests
Plotting library for analysis (not used in Story 2.6)

story-context.constraints: - Follow Gym-like API pattern (Architecture ADR-004): step returns (obs, reward, done, info) - run() must return float (cumulative reward), not dict or tuple - simplest interface for researchers - Handle exceptions at API boundary with clear, informative error messages - Preserve episode state and history - don't mutate state unexpectedly - State dict is single source of truth - all state updates happen atomically within methods - Use NumPy-style docstrings with comprehensive documentation (Parameters, Returns, Raises, Notes, Examples) - Type hints mandatory on all method signatures - Performance requirement: 1000-step episode in < 2 seconds headless (NFR3) - Headless mode (render=False) has no visualization overhead - Visualizer integration is placeholder for Epic 4 - check hasattr(self, 'visualizer') before using - If render=True but visualizer=None, print warning once and continue headless - Agent exceptions must be caught and re-raised with context (agent type, timestep, original error)

interface.name: Environment.step
interface.signature: def step(self, action: int) -> tuple[dict, float, bool, dict]

interface.name: Environment.run
interface.signature: def run(self, agent: Agent, render: bool = False) -> float

tests.standards: Testing standards from Architecture and existing tests: - Use pytest framework with fixtures from conftest.py - Fixture-based test setup: gaussian_function, environment, mock_agent - Test classes organized by functionality (e.g., TestRunMethod for run() tests) - Test naming: test__ (e.g., test_run_completes_episode) - NumPy-style docstrings on test methods explaining what is being tested - Performance tests use timeit for timing validation - Edge case coverage: exception handling, multiple episodes, render modes - Integration tests validate cross-component interaction - All tests must pass before story completion - Test coverage target: >90% for new run() method
tests.locations: tests/test_environment.py - Add new TestRunMethod class tests/conftest.py - Use existing fixtures (gaussian_function, environment, mock_agent)
tests.ideas:
**Unit Tests for run() Method:** 1. test_run_completes_episode - Verify run() executes full episode and returns float 2. test_run_returns_cumulative_reward - Verify return value matches state['cumulative_reward'] 3. test_run_calls_reset_and_step - Verify correct method sequence (reset → loop → return) 4. test_run_preserves_history - Verify episode history tracked correctly during run() 5. test_run_multiple_sequential_episodes - Verify run() can be called multiple times with reset between
**Performance Tests:** 6. test_run_performance_headless - Verify 1000-step episode completes in < 2 seconds (render=False) 7. test_run_performance_small_episode - Verify 100-step episode completes quickly
**Render Mode Tests:** 8. test_run_render_false - Verify headless execution (render=False) 9. test_run_render_true_no_visualizer - Verify warning printed when render=True but visualizer=None (use capsys fixture) 10. test_run_render_warning_shown_once - Verify warning only printed once, not every run()
**Exception Handling Tests:** 11. test_run_agent_exception_handling - Create mock agent that raises exception, verify informative error with agent type and timestep 12. test_run_agent_exception_preserves_state - Verify exception doesn't corrupt environment state
**Integration Tests:** 13. test_run_with_mock_agent - Full episode with simple mock agent (always goes right) 14. test_run_with_random_agent - Full episode with RandomAgent (if available from Story 3.1) 15. test_run_cumulative_reward_accuracy - Verify final reward equals sum of individual step rewards 16. test_run_done_flag_termination - Verify episode stops when done=True
Map to ACs: - AC1 (episode execution): Tests 1, 2, 3, 13, 14, 16 - AC2 (returns float): Tests 1, 2, 15 - AC3 (performance): Tests 6, 7 - AC4 (exception handling): Tests 11, 12 - AC5 (render warning): Tests 9, 10 - AC6 (docstring): Code review validates comprehensive documentation
